goal: Fix /app/schedule right-side arrangements so they are localized, data-backed, and clickable into contact or event detail pages.

success_criteria.description: GET /app/schedule right-side arrangements render localized person or event names, reasons, timing, and source context instead of placeholder strings such as Review follow-up for contact_021.
Each arrangement item has a valid href to either a contact detail route or an event detail route, and tests verify those targets resolve to existing route ids.
The schedule route view model maps arrangement records through typed contact, event, and follow-up context rather than displaying raw ids as primary copy.
Empty, pending, and failure schedule states keep localized recovery controls and do not mix English labels into Chinese UI copy.
The schedule documentation explains the arrangement data contract and the future live provider replacement boundary.

out_of_scope: Adding calendar writes or external scheduler sync
Changing contact or event detail page layouts
